caption:
In four months, India exported more than most countries do in a year. And it's still accelerating.

India's cumulative merchandise and services exports hit $316.42 billion between April and July of FY2026-27 - up 13.16% year-on-year. May alone set the record for India's highest-ever monthly merchandise exports, at $45.2 billion.

The trade deficit is narrowing at the same time, as exports grow faster than imports.

A country doesn't export its way to relevance by accident. It takes factories, ports, and supply chains all moving in the same direction, every single month.

Sources: PIB, Organiser, News on Air (2026)
